source.note: One of the 6 distinct shapes in the Corridor collection; this one repeats 16 times. Textured once and reused across its instances -- a unique bake of the whole corridor is 26,028 m2, which is ~6 px/m at 1024 against the preset's 512 px/m target. Source slots are SketchUp defaults (FrontColor carries every face, BackColor none), hence drop_empty_slots + rename_slots.

painter.note: Colour comes from CC0 image maps: shelf smart materials insert structure but contribute no colour in a legacy colour-managed project.
